lines: 逐项分析[A] 担忧毫无根据 → 作者承认威胁，错；[B] 乐观者观点无依据 → 作者引用乐观者但补充中期需帮助，错；[C] 自动化带来的问题需应对 → 正确；[D] 负面后果可避免 → 过于绝对。

lines: 解题依据E段是全文总起："The Eisenhower Executive Office Building (EEOB) commands a unique position in both the national history and the architectural heritage…built from 1871 to 1888…" 先总体介绍该楼地位与建造年代，适合作为首段。

analysis.source: legacy/考研英语一真题逐题精讲_2010-2024.html

nodes.label: 完整推导
lines: 解题依据C段后回溯历史：G段"The history of the EEOB began long before its foundations were laid…1799-1820…1866…demolition of the State Department building." 时间线从最早办公场所讲到1866年旧楼被拆，自然引出下文建楼。

analysis.source: legacy/考研英语一真题逐题精讲_2010-2024.html

nodes.label: 完整推导
lines: 解题依据G段末"1866年拆除旧国务院大楼"，A段开头"In December of 1869, Congress appointed a commission to select a site…construction began in June of 1871." 时间、事件完美承接；A段末"1871年6月开工"又接F段"Construction took 17 years…"。

analysis.source: legacy/考研英语一真题逐题精讲_2010-2024.html

nodes.label: 完整推导
lines: 解题依据F段讲"逐翼建起、落成时规模巨大"，B段"Completed in 1875, the State Department's south wing was the first to be occupied…Navy moved into the east wing in 1879" 具体讲各翼何时投入使用，承接"wing by wing"。

analysis.source: legacy/考研英语一真题逐题精讲_2010-2024.html

nodes.label: 完整推导
lines: 解题依据B段讲建筑投入使用，D段"Many of the most celebrated national figures have participated in historical events within the EEOB's granite walls…Theodore and Franklin Roosevelt…Churchill…Pearl Harbor" 列举在此办公过的名人，作结收束全文。

nodes.label: 易错深挖
lines: 解题铁律排序题抓时间线（1799→1866→1869→1871→1875→1879→1888）和代词/复现词（the building / its wings / historic events）。
